subject: Upshift renewal kickoff: term options, capacity request, and QBR
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Brooks <alyssa.brooks@novaterra.com>, Tom Heller <tom.heller@novaterra.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Oct 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Upshift renewal kickoff: term options, capacity request, and QBR

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. I wanted to kick off a short renewal thread so we have a single place for timeline, stakeholders, and next steps as you evaluate a term extension + capacity uplift. High-level items in scope:

- Term options (12 / 24 / 36 months) with corresponding price breaks and commit cadence
- Capacity uplift: request for additional reserved GPU throughput in month 1 and staged burst capacity for seasonality
- QBR to review performance, SLOs, and post-upgrade runbook
- Procurement path and DocuSign timeline

Quick asks from our side to keep momentum:
1) Please confirm the primary renewal decision-maker and procurement contact (I included a procurement alias in case you want to loop them).
2) Confirm whether the uplift needs coverage starting Nov 1 or Jan 1 (we’ll model both).
3) Share any internal blackout dates for an hour-long QBR in the next 3 weeks.

I’ve attached a one-page term_summary_3-options.docx and a draft Mutual Action Plan (Novaterra_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx) with milestones + a proposed DocuSign milestone. For the QBR, proposed slots: Oct 15 (09:00–10:00 PT), Oct 18 (13:00–14:00 PT), or Oct 22 (11:00–12:00 PT). I can also run a short demo of the new Dedicated autoscale profiles if helpful.

Marissa — can you confirm the pricing comps and a quick runbook we’d use for the uplift? Karthik / Soojin — FYI on capacity planning and security checklist items respectively.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0107

Attachments: term_summary_3-options.docx (docx), Novaterra_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Alyssa Brooks <alyssa.brooks@novaterra.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Heller <tom.heller@novaterra.com>, Novaterra Procurement <procurement@novaterra.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Oct 2029 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upshift renewal kickoff: term options, capacity request, and QBR

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear summary and the attachments. Quick responses:

- Decision-makers: I’m the primary product sponsor, Tom (cc) is leading the commercial review, and our procurement team (procurement@novaterra.com) handles contracting.
- Preferred uplift start: Ideally Nov 1 to cover our holiday campaign test window; if pricing or provisioning is tight we could consider Jan 1 but Nov 1 is preferable.
- QBR windows: Oct 15 is tight for our execs; Oct 18 (13:00–14:00 PT) looks best.

A few asks from our side:
1) Can you include a short FAQ for our procurement team with billing cadence and termination terms?
2) We have a security review in progress — Soojin, if you can confirm SOC2/retention controls we can expedite.
3) Please surface the SLA uplift (if any) tied to the reserved capacity and any credits for missed targets.

We’re also going to invite a technical lead from our platform team; I’ll forward their contact once confirmed.

Onward —
Alyssa
Head of Product, Novaterra
alyssa.brooks@novaterra.com

Date: Thu, 03 Oct 2029 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upshift renewal kickoff: pricing comps and runbook

Markus / team —

Attached a short pricing comp worksheet (summary tab) and an ops runbook draft for the uplift. Highlights:
- 12-month: modest uplift but highest unit price; good if they value flexibility.
- 24-month: our recommended balance — ~12% psu price reduction, 2-week provisioning SLA for additional reserved capacity.
- 36-month: best unit economics (~18% reduction) but requires standard commit terms.

Runbook notes for Nov 1 uplift:
- Staffing: we’ll plan a 2-week ops window for provisioning + smoke tests; SE on-call day of switch. Karthik, confirm GPU pool capacity and any pre-warm requirements.
- Fallback: if provisioning misses the Nov 1 window we’ll provide transient burst credits equal to 1 week of expected overage.
- Billing: monthly invoice with committed discount applied; procurement FAQ (attached) outlines termination notice windows and pro-rated refunds for downgrades.

Soojin — can you confirm the SOC2 control packets and retention statements so Alyssa’s security team has a single PDF they can circulate?

I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite for Oct 18 13:00 PT once Alyssa confirms.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: QBR-Agenda-v1.pdf, Novaterra_pricing-comp.xlsx

Subject: Re: Upshift renewal kickoff: QBR confirmed and next steps

Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turn. Oct 18 13:00–14:00 PT is locked on our side; invite sent to the participants listed. Agenda attached (QBR-Agenda-v1.pdf) — we’ll cover current utilization, uplift plan, SLA commitments, and a 15-minute demo of Dedicated autoscale.

Next steps summary:
- Marissa will publish final pricing comps and procurement FAQ by EOD Oct 5.
- Soojin to provide SOC2/retention packet (PDF) and a short note about data residency options by Oct 7.
- Karthik to confirm pool capacity and pre-warm timeline by Oct 9; if we can pre-warm the pool we’ll meet Nov 1 provision target.
- Novaterra procurement to review the attached Mutual Action Plan and confirm DocuSign milestone owner.

I’ve attached the MAP and a DocuSign link placeholder in case procurement wants to start the signature flow right after QBR. If anyone has a preferred contract template, please share it and we’ll run the redlines in parallel.

See you on Oct 18.

Best,
Markus

Attachments: Novaterra_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, DocuSign-link-placeholder.txt
